meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 安装 OneCLI 并初始化它的 Agent Vault 凭据保险库,把 .env 里现存的 API 密钥等凭据迁移进保险库,再从 .env 中删除这些密钥。之后凭据由保险库在网关层注入,agent 不再直接接触原始密钥。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 把 OneCLI 作为破坏性变更引入之后,或首次搭建 OneCLI 时触发。

say.text: 我刚跑完 /update-nanoclaw,帮我初始化 OneCLI
say.note: 完整跑一遍安装和迁移流程。

say.text: 检查 OneCLI 是否已配置,没有就重装
say.note: 先做预检,缺失则走安装流程。

howto.what_en: Installs OneCLI and its Agent Vault gateway, migrates existing `.env` credentials into the vault, and removes them from `.env`. After setup, credentials are injected at the gateway level; agents never see the raw keys.
howto.when_en: Use after `/update-nanoclaw` introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

say_en.text: I just ran /update-nanoclaw, please set up OneCLI.
say_en.note: Runs the full install and migration flow.

say_en.text: Migrate ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from .env to the OneCLI vault.
say_en.note: Moves the key into the vault and removes it from .env.

say_en.text: Check whether OneCLI is configured; reinstall if not.
say_en.note: Pre-flight check, then installs if missing.
